name: Skyprythem
source:
Kazuki has just entered the school. After an entrance ceremony, his classroom teacher tells the class, "We are going to have the same wing." Same wing.... This means every classmate works together for the same goal. Yes, they are gonna compose a song which will be played at the school music festival. Each student has to find a partner and compose a song together. It is called the "Feather Partner". Though there are various girls at school, who will Kazuki choose as his partner? 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一树刚刚入学。开学典礼结束后，班主任对全班说道：“我们将拥有同一双翅膀。”同一双翅膀…这意味着所有同学都要为了共同目标合作。没错，他们将创作一首在校园音乐祭上演奏的歌曲。每名学生必须寻找一位搭档，共同作曲，这种组合被称为“羽翼搭档”。学校里有各种各样的少女，一树会选择谁作为自己的搭档？

[摘自ErogeShop]
